question: Is the additive `media_unavailable_at` migration plus the current live validation enough to accept persistent unavailable-media state for `media retry` before merge?
rationale: Static review can check that the migration is additive and tested, but accepting a new persistent skip state for user media recovery is a maintainer data-model and upgrade-safety choice.

options.title: Accept migration-backed retry
options.body: Proceed with the feature if the migration repair test and live store-open validation are sufficient for the maintainer's upgrade-safety bar.

options.title: Require exact positive recovery proof
options.body: Ask for redacted output from this exact branch showing at least one recovered file before merge.

options.title: Defer persisted unavailable state
options.body: Keep retry recovery but avoid or redesign permanent unavailable marking until the state semantics are settled.

recommendation.title: Accept migration-backed retry
recommendation.body: Proceed with the feature if the migration repair test and live store-open validation are sufficient for the maintainer's upgrade-safety bar.

likelyOwner.reason: This PR is a collaborator-authored split from prior media work, and steipete has the clearest current decision trail in the related PR discussion and branch ownership.
